name: T06-doze-deep
description: Screen off, then deep doze forced immediately after. Pre-armed so force-idle lands ~0.3s after ON_STOP rather than ~2s.

steps.why: clear the minimum-upload-interval gate; without this the ON_STOP upload is debounced and the run measures the debounce instead of the question
covers the ~5s background network cutoff plus at least one ~30s timed flush
